notes.title: v 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello! ːsteamhappyː
Today we have updated the game to version 1.0.6.
List of changes:
1) Many optimizations
2) In the battle, they returned 4x acceleration.
3) The stats of heroes added a button to reduce the increased characteristics.
4) Minor bug fixes

We are still continuing to optimize the game and soon we will rebalance the heroes and finalize the game.

notes.title: Future of the project
notes.content:
Friends!
We apologize for such a long lack of updates.
In connection with the relocation of the developer to another country for some time it was not possible to engage in the project.
But now everything is fine and in the near future we will release an update that fixes the found bugs, adds optimization and corrects the balance.
After that we will add new content and finalize the game to a full release and add new languages!

notes.title: v 1.0.3
notes.content:
We make big work, hope you like it:

1) New game mechanic "Shields". When ranged defender hit shield (for example archer) - arrow reflect to different way.
https://youtu.be/Dsc81MWVo1s
2) New game mechanic "Headshot". All enemy now have "body" and "head". When defender hit "head" - it does more damage. 
https://youtu.be/4NNcsrxeEPQ
3) 4 new card "Headshot". Cards give to defender command - aim to head 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% of shots.
